class.name: InventoryFragmentQuickBarIcon
class.brief_description: How an item looks in a quick bar slot.
class.description: Also what makes a [QuickBarComponent] with [member QuickBarComponent.auto_slot_new_items] put the item into a free slot by itself.

members.member: A stat tag shown as the slot's number (ammo, charges). Empty shows the stack size when it is above one.
Shown instead of the definition's name while the item is the active slot. Empty uses the display name.
